play_name: Stop checking and get a real answer
behavioral_target: Checking old messages or their online status to feel sure, instead of getting real information.
trigger: You feel unsure where things stand, so you reread the chat or check when they were last online.
old_play: You go back over old words or watch their online time to look for an answer on your own.
function_of_old_play: It gives you a small sense of an answer without having to ask or wait.
new_play: When you catch yourself checking, name the one thing you really want to know. Then ask it in plain words, or watch what they actually do next.
what_to_expect: You may have to sit with not knowing for a bit, and give up the small hit you get from checking. A real answer may be one you don't like.
why_supports_task: Discernment means learning to read a person from real facts. Asking or watching real actions gives you facts. Rereading and status-checking only feed the worry.
maintaining_behaviors_consolidated: Rereading conversations over and over (STM-0273); checking when they were last online (STM-0420).
context_limitations: This is about easing the worry-checking loop, not about ignoring real safety concerns.

play_name: Ask for what you need instead of testing
behavioral_target: Setting up secret tests to see if you can depend on someone.
trigger: You are not sure you can count on this person, so you test them without telling them.
old_play: You set up small tests and watch to see if they pass, instead of asking straight out.
function_of_old_play: It lets you check if you can count on them without having to say what you need.
new_play: Name one real thing you need. Ask for it in plain words. Then watch, over time, if they come through.
what_to_expect: You have to say your need out loud, which can feel risky. They might not come through, and that answer tells you something too.
why_supports_task: Discernment means finding out if someone is dependable from real tries. A clear need plus real follow-through gives you a true read; secret tests give mixed, unclear results.
maintaining_behaviors_consolidated: Testing to see whether you can actually depend on them (STM-1054).
context_limitations: Wanting to know if someone is dependable is healthy; this play only changes secret tests into a clear ask plus real observing.
review_reason: Rests on reading STM-1054 as contrived testing rather than plain observing; candidate-section item, so the maintaining call could shift on review.
